notes: Templates are patterns with {placeholders} resolved by the generator. Composite placeholders (site, filetypeGroup, exclusions, ...) resolve to full operator syntax or to nothing.

Placeholders that resolve to nothing cause the template to be skipped unless they are optional. Optional by default: exclusions, dates, after, before, site, siteOption, context. Override per template with requires/optional.
when lists the input types a template applies to. Weight is the base ranking score. family groups templates into precision lenses.
keywords -> {keywords} = ("a" OR "b"). exclude -> extra static -term exclusions. fileTypes overrides the intent's defaultFileTypes. platformIds/platformCategories/platformLimit feed {platformSites}.
